_comment: Editorial guide for /caribbean/belize. Its presence makes the Belize country guide indexable even though Belize has fewer than GATES.COUNTRY_MIN family-eligible resorts (see indexability() in scripts/lib/family-rules.mjs). Every fact below cites its source and verification date. Re-verify before changing; never add a resort that does not admit children.
title: Best Family Resorts in Belize: Where to Stay With Kids
h1: Best Family Resorts in Belize: Where to Stay With Kids
description: 4 Belize resorts admit children; 2 fit a family of 4+ in one unit. Verified rooms, age rules and the full arrival route from BZE, plus a live trip search.

airport.name: Philip S. W. Goldson International Airport (Belize City)

quickAnswer: Four Belize resorts in our catalogue admit children. Only two can sleep a family of four or more in a single unit: Alaia Belize on Ambergris Caye (2-bedroom suites for up to 5, 3-bedroom suites for up to 7) and Belizean Dreams in Hopkins (2-bedroom suites for 4, 3-bedroom villas for up to 6). Every family flies into BZE; Alaia and the cayes then need a boat or a short domestic flight, while Hopkins is a road transfer.

resorts.name: Alaia Belize, Autograph Collection
resorts.ageRule: Children of any age are allowed; children 2 and under stay free in an available cot (cots and extra beds on request).
resorts.beach: Oceanfront. The resort notes a seawall, so direct water entry is limited; the Belize Barrier Reef Reserve is about 600 yards offshore.
resorts.allInclusive: All-inclusive rates have been seen for this resort.
